decision: Prefer existing Ring<Frame*> with stable per-job packet and stage-specific loads. No static/dummy ABI implementation promoted.
packet_shape: eight mutable 16 B vectors, each two uint64 lanes; per-job values differ initially and after every payload stage
per_job_oracle: Independent scalar std::array updates all 16 lanes for each of eight jobs over seven metadata/payload cycles; verifies remaining=0, sum and all lanes separately plus total checksum=61480. Production additionally verifies eight completions and 112 native visits.

storageFootprint.limits: sizeof(Frame)/sizeof(Slot) only. Excludes Ring object, inventory arrays, allocator rounding and Worker/arena. Native arm retains initialized Frame packet while its mutable packet is carried in Slot; pointer arm has one mutable owning packet.

bounded_negatives.prototype_mode1: Static wrapper inlines and selective scalar store removes 128 B writes, but metadata still restores 128 B vectors because forwarded opaque transfer arguments remain live.
bounded_negatives.prototype_modes2_3: Zero/nondeterministic dummies eliminate packet loads/stores, but both emit eight vector clears; Clang freeze poison chooses zero. No observed benefit of nondeterministic builtin.
bounded_negatives.qualification: Standalone static prototype admits only bound wrappers. No mixed raw/static fallback qualified; existing generic raw callbacks retain eager restore. No uninitialized reads or UB dummies.

codegen_limits: AArch64 Clang 21.1.8 local compilation. Instruction counts include exit and alignment nops and are not cycle estimates. Selected metadata snippets only; one indirect branch and no ordinary call in each.
timing_limits: Warm OrbStack Apple AArch64 VM, CPU 0; tune flag neoverse-v2 is codegen setting, not measured V2 hardware. Eight warm jobs with no required cache miss or prefetch. Samples are exploratory composition mechanism evidence, not native AMAC throughput.
full_yield_vs_unchanged_confound: Production native packet metadata uses current full yield to persist changed sum and all arguments, including compatibility completed branch. Pointer metadata updates Frame sum directly then uses yield_unchanged. Comparison includes that API/control-flow difference, Slot size and reset/admission/publication work; it does not isolate restore-only savings.
selection: Exact two source files, exact original receipts/check outputs, six metadata snippets, frontend/optimized builtin excerpt, all 66 warm sample rows with order, header snapshot and provenance. No binaries, full LLVM IR or full disassembly retained.
